I had blood and urine tests done at CMF Lab while staying in Chiang Mai and I was truly impressed.

The staff were extremely kind, welcoming, and professional. The whole process was very smooth and efficient, everything was done quickly and without any hassle. I received my results by email in less than two hours, which was amazing.

The facility is clean, well organized, and highly efficient. Prices are incredibly affordable, especially considering the quality of the service.

I highly recommend this lab to anyone needing medical tests in Chiang Mai. I will definitely come back.

text: Very professional friendly and fast turnaround highly recommend

CMF lab is very professional and efficient! I bought the premier package, and when one of my cancer marker tests came back unexpectedly high, compared to the year before, they re did the test immediately,  on request, to confirm the results.  Within 24 hours, I was organising medical follow ups. Highly recommend!!

CMF Lab Chiang Mai has excellent service. The staff are very helpful, providing good advice and answering customer questions. The medical technologists are highly skilled, and test results are available quickly. The prices are reasonable.

Went here after the lab my Thai doctor recommended could not accommodate English speakers and I had a great experience!
Yes, the 9 am opening time is a bit more difficult when fasting but you can make an appointment and be taken care of immediately.
Pricing structure is posted online and inside, clearly outlined and easy to understand. When I requested a test that was already part of the package I purchased it was explained so I would not be charged double.
Note that here you go straight to the lab for blood/urine tests, no doctors visit or orders necessary.
Facility was very clean, service efficient, and credit card payment was possible.
This lab is definitely the best option for foreigners in Chiang Mai!
